Security wrapper ATP_SEC_VerifyData (libmsgapi address 0x14648, size 204) checks length and calls ATP_SEC_DigestDataEx, then dispatches through unresolved function pointer/context. ATP_SEC_VerifyDataEx at 0x14d2c size 172. ATP_SEC_CreateSignatureContext at 0x14be8 size 324.

recommended_next_step: Do not produce an OEM update package. Seek Huawei/vendor-signed documentation or an authorized update service/key custody path that explicitly defines component-1 RootFS update eligibility and signature contract. In parallel, pursue only a non-flashing userspace compatibility prototype in an isolated lab using the original kernel, with a verified recovery path and explicit operator-controlled launch; keep it separate from original firmware artifacts.
scope: Read-only host-side static inspection. No OEM binary execution, MTD access, flash write, firmware modification, or device validation.
